title: The Live Charity Marathon
teaser: Twenty hours into a charity marathon, Nika Sokol stepped away from the camera "for a minute". Forty thousand viewers stared at an empty chair, and then a hand flashed into the shot and turned off the light. Nika was found dead on the roof of the loft, and the money raised overnight had vanished from the charity's account. Chat is still arguing whose hand it was, and the stream is being replayed frame by frame.

habits.label: Headphones round the neck
habits.habit: Big headphones always hang round their neck
clues: A soft ear cushion from big headphones lies on the roof parapet. The culprit wears headphones round their neck.
A headphone adapter with a bit of torn cable lies on the floor of the server cupboard. The culprit wears headphones round their neck.

habits.label: Energy drinks
habits.habit: Drinks energy drinks one can after another
clues: A crushed energy drink can, still wet, lies on the stairs to the roof. The culprit drinks energy drinks.
There's a sticky, sweet-smelling patch on the floor of the goods lift, like spilled energy drink. The culprit drinks energy drinks.

habits.label: Pink hair
clues: There's a long bright pink hair on the collar of Nika's jacket, and Nika is blonde. The culprit has pink hair.
A towel in the make-up room has pink streaks from fresh hair dye. The culprit has pink hair.

habits.label: Cat ears
clues: A fluffy ear snapped off a headband lies on the floor of the goods lift. The culprit wears a cat-ears headband.
A neighbour across the street filming the city at night happened to catch the loft roof: against the sky there's a silhouette with two pointy ears. The culprit wears a cat-ears headband.

habits.label: Marathon hoodie
habits.habit: Wears a hoodie with the marathon logo
clues: The hand that turned off the light in the studio was in a sleeve with the edge of the embroidered marathon logo. The culprit wears the marathon hoodie.
A scrap of black jersey with a white embroidered letter, like on the marathon hoodie, is caught on the rusty door to the roof. The culprit wears the marathon hoodie.

habits.label: Stickers on the phone
clues: A small sticker of a cartoon cat is stuck to the roof parapet; it looks like it came off a phone case. The culprit covers their phone in stickers.
A heart sticker, the kind people put on phone cases, lies under the desk in the moderators' room. The culprit covers their phone in stickers.

habits.label: Watermelon vape
clues: The frosty loft roof smells of sweet watermelon, and Nika didn't smoke. The culprit vapes watermelon.
The smoke detector in the server cupboard is taped over, and the air is full of sweet watermelon vapour. The culprit vapes watermelon.

habits.label: Rhinestone nails
clues: A tiny rhinestone is stuck under Nika's nail, though her own nails are short and plain. The culprit has rhinestone nails.
The lid of the server rack in the cupboard has long thin scratches, like from false nails. The culprit has rhinestone nails.

habits.label: Rings on the fingers
habits.habit: Chunky rings on nearly every finger
clues: The metal handrail of the stairs to the roof has fresh scratches, as if gripped by a hand in chunky rings. The culprit wears lots of rings.
On the stream recording, metal glinted on three fingers of the hand that turned off the light. The culprit wears lots of rings.

habits.label: Light-up trainers
habits.habit: Wears trainers with lights in the soles
clues: When the studio went dark, viewers noticed two blinking pink lights right by the floor. The culprit wears light-up trainers.
The camera in the goods lift couldn't make out anything in the dark except blinking lights right by the floor. The culprit wears light-up trainers.

habits.label: Dry cough
habits.habit: Has a cold and a dry cough
clues: The studio mic picked up a dry cough a second before the light went out. The culprit has a cold and a cough.
A packet of cough drops has been opened in the loft kitchen, and two of their wrappers turned up on the roof. The culprit has a cold and a cough.

habits.label: Fake glasses
habits.habit: Wears plain-glass glasses for the look
clues: A plastic lens, flat as window glass, fell out of its frame on the loft roof. The culprit wears fake glasses.
An empty case labelled "Style glasses, no prescription" was left in the make-up room. The culprit wears fake glasses.

habits.label: Gummy bears
clues: A squashed gummy bear is stuck to the sole of Nika's boot. The culprit has gummy bears in their pockets.
A keyboard in the moderators' room has a sticky patch and a green gummy bear head on it. The culprit has gummy bears in their pockets.

habits.label: Glitter on the cheeks
clues: The roof parapet has silvery dust on it, like face glitter. The culprit wears glitter on their face.
There's silver glitter at cheek height on the goods lift door. The culprit wears glitter on their face.

habits.label: Cracks knuckles
clues: Before the light went out, the studio recording clearly picks up knuckles cracking. The culprit cracks their knuckles.
The guard in the lift lobby heard someone cracking their knuckles in the goods lift. The culprit cracks their knuckles.

habits.label: Wallet chain
habits.habit: A long chain hanging from their jeans
clues: The sound engineer heard a metallic clink from the roof, as if a chain had hit the railing. The culprit wears a chain on their jeans.
A link from a jeans chain with a bent clasp lies on the floor of the server cupboard. The culprit wears a chain on their jeans.

tech: The studio camera wasn't switched off but frozen on a frame of the empty chair, and viewers watched a still image for twenty minutes. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
At 03:30 the charity's account number in the donation settings was swapped for someone else's, from the computer in the server cupboard. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
sched: At 03:30 the marathon plan had a twenty-minute sponsor video, and everyone knew Nika would step out of frame then. The culprit knows the schedule.
The office building guard does his round at half past three, and nobody watches the roof then. The culprit knows the schedule.
strong: The heavy door to the roof was barred from the inside with two sacks of cement that normally take two people to carry. The culprit is physically strong.
Nika fought back, and her arms have bruises from a very strong grip. The culprit is physically strong.
cash: The marathon money was taken in three transfers, each within the limit, and the charity's account was logged into with the right password. The culprit had access to money.
Exactly the amount collected for everyone's pizza is missing from the envelope of shared money in the loft kitchen. The culprit had access to money.
safe: The safe in the make-up room, where Nika kept a memory stick with her passwords, was opened without a sign of force, and the stick is gone. The culprit knows the safe combination.
The combination locker in the moderators' room, where the spare passes are kept, is open, and one pass is missing. The culprit knows the safe combination.
quiet: The moderators sat a metre from the roof door but heard neither footsteps nor the door bang. The culprit moves silently.
The studio mic catches every rustle, yet the recording has no sound of anyone passing behind Nika. The culprit moves silently.
tools: The door to the roof was taken off its hinges and put back, the screws neatly tightened. The culprit is handy with tools.
The studio lamp cable wasn't cut with a knife but with wire cutters, right at the connector. The culprit is handy with tools.
driver: Nika's manager's car left the entrance at 03:35 and came back ten minutes later, and the driver's seat has been pushed back. The culprit can drive.
There's a delivery scooter with a warm engine by the entrance, though the courier swears he didn't go anywhere for an hour. The culprit can drive.
medic: A heart medication was slipped into the coffee Nika drank on stream, and the dose was calculated exactly. The culprit knows about poisons.
An ampoule is missing from the first-aid kit in the loft kitchen, and the empty one was thrown into the sharps box so it wouldn't stand out. The culprit knows about poisons.
keys: The roof door was opened with its own key, which hangs on the loft owner's shared ring. The culprit had keys.
The server cupboard was opened and locked again, and only three people have keys to it. The culprit had keys.
french: At 03:38 an anonymous message came into the marathon chat: "C'est fini, Nika", French for "It's over, Nika". The culprit knows French.
"Menteuse", French for "Liar", is written in lipstick on the make-up room mirror. The culprit knows French.
passages: A fire escape few people remember leads from the loft roof to the server cupboard, and the hatch isn't locked. The culprit knows the service passages.
At night the goods lift only works with a staff card, yet at 03:39 it went up to the roof. The culprit knows the service passages.
